raw_observations_archive.note: byte-exact tracked copies of all run records plus both run manifests and both timing artifacts; the archive sha256 is also bound into the FLOW-11 bundle (source RAW-OBSERVATIONS, claim c8-raw-archive) and therefore into the evidence pack

decision.question: QA3 retrieval/index isolation: per-scope index versus shared index with row-level retrieval filtering (shared-RLS)
decision.recommendation: per-scope index projections bound to the canonical (tenant, workspace, goal) scope with frozen cache/epoch invalidation semantics

sensitivity.policy: weights-only perturbation; every scored cell was a measured number, so no unknown-bound swing applies (unknown-bound analysis would activate only if a cell scored NO_DATA)

per_variant_evidence.D6_blast_radius: per_scope 4.0 (worst single fault: one misfiled projection entry, 1/3 scopes) vs shared_rls 3.25 (predicate bypass exposes 2/3 scopes + corrupt entry 1/3); cells cite distinct per-variant fault data
per_variant_evidence.D10_overhead: directional: the costlier variant scores strictly lower on measured storage bytes and rows scanned
per_variant_evidence.timing: statistic, tolerance and verdict recomputed by the evaluator from raw hash-bound paired samples of BOTH executions; producer summaries ignored

decision.migration_trigger: away from per-scope projections only when a documented need for cross-scope ranked federation inside ONE trust boundary coincides with measured evidence that per-scope projection maintenance exceeds a shared predicate layer at equal ISO1-ISO8 compliance; rollback is symmetric (rebuild projections from the canonical object store)
decision.non_goals: no production search service/vendor choice, no ranking optimization, no profile-C MLS/TEE rollout (S1-018), no <=5s revocation SLO claim (S1-008), no core AgentOS rewrites

limitations: All results are local-model measurements from a deterministic stdlib-only simulation; no production latency, storage or privacy certification is claimed.

The timing probe is a bounded same-host paired-interleaved wall-clock measurement (200 paired samples x 32 inner repeats x 3 seeds per variant, tolerance max(10% of control median, 2000ns) recomputed by the evaluator from raw samples); it cannot prove absence of all side channels.
D9 (operational complexity/migration) and D11 (profile compatibility) are inference-type cells derived from the frozen contract, the current implementation and documented profiles.
Storage overhead uses a declared fixed per-index constant (256 bytes) - a model assumption, not a measurement of a production index engine.
S1-003 and S1-005 evidence is reused only within its stated limits (see dependency-gate.json).
Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
